props.name: loopFocus
props.description:
Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item
when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the whole menubar is disabled.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: Determines the orientation of the menubar.

dataAttributes.name: data-has-submenu-open
dataAttributes.description: Present when any submenu within the menubar is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-modal
dataAttributes.description: Present when the corresponding menubar is modal.

additionalTypes.name: Menubar.State
